feature_note: 前 7 项参与打分；bg_ratio 只用于解释（背景剔除前后的占比），不参与匹配。所有比值均在前景像素上计算：先按最外一圈像素估计背景色并剔除，避免「白纸衬底」把 whitish_ratio 顶高而误判成白粉病。

i18n_status.ug-CN: pending — 专业农技内容需母语者+农技员校对，当前回退中文

zh-CN: 下部老叶先出现褐色圆形斑，斑上有同心轮纹
病斑扩大后连片，叶片自下而上枯黄
潮湿时病斑边缘可见黑色霉层
en-US: Brown circular spots with concentric rings appear on lower leaves first
Spots merge and leaves wilt from bottom upward
Dark mould visible on spot margins in humid weather

cause.zh-CN: 由茄链格孢菌引起。高温高湿、植株长势弱、连作地块发病重，雨水飞溅是主要传播途径。
cause.en-US: Caused by Alternaria solani. Favoured by warm humid weather, weak plants and continuous cropping; spread mainly by rain splash.

zh-CN: 摘除下部病叶并带出田外销毁，不要留在地里
适当疏叶通风，降低田间湿度
与非茄科作物轮作 2 年以上
发病初期即开始用药，7~10 天一次，连喷 2~3 次
en-US: Remove and destroy lower infected leaves off-field
Thin leaves to improve airflow and lower humidity
Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for 2+ years
Spray from early onset, every 7-10 days, 2-3 times

zh-CN: 苯醚甲环唑 1500 倍液
代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
嘧菌酯 2000 倍液
en-US: Difenoconazole 1:1500
Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)
Azoxystrobin 1:2000

zh-CN: 叶缘出现暗绿色水渍状斑，迅速扩大
病斑由暗绿转褐色，叶背有白色霉层
茎秆出现黑褐色条斑，果实变硬褐腐
en-US: Dark water-soaked lesions start at leaf margins and expand fast
Lesions turn brown with white mould on the underside
Stems show dark streaks; fruits rot with firm brown patches

cause.zh-CN: 由致病疫霉引起。低温高湿（18~22℃、相对湿度 85% 以上）时爆发极快，一晚即可毁田。
cause.en-US: Caused by Phytophthora infestans. Explodes under cool humid conditions (18-22C, RH above 85%), can destroy a field overnight.

zh-CN: 发现中心病株立即拔除并带出田外深埋
严格控制浇水，避免叶面长时间结露
雨前抢喷保护性药剂，雨后补喷治疗性药剂
棚室要及时放风排湿
en-US: Rogue out and deep-bury the first infected plants immediately
Avoid overhead irrigation and prolonged leaf wetness
Spray protectant before rain, curative after
Vent greenhouses to remove humidity

zh-CN: 烯酰吗啉 800 倍液
霜脲·锰锌 600 倍液
氟菌·霜霉威 800 倍液
en-US: Dimethomorph 1:800
Cymoxanil+Mancozeb 1:600
Fluopicolide+Propamocarb 1:800

zh-CN: 叶面出现白色近圆形粉斑，像撒了面粉
粉斑连成大片，叶片变黄发脆
后期白粉变灰褐，叶片干枯但不脱落
en-US: White powdery round patches on leaves, like flour dust
Patches merge, leaves turn yellow and brittle
Powder turns grey-brown late; leaves dry but stay attached

cause.zh-CN: 由单囊壳菌引起。空气干燥与高湿交替、光照不足、通风差、氮肥偏多时发病重。
cause.en-US: Caused by Podosphaera xanthii. Favoured by alternating dry/humid air, poor light, poor ventilation and excess nitrogen.

zh-CN: 及时摘除下部重病叶，改善通风透光
控氮增钾，避免植株徒长
早晚叶面喷清水可抑制孢子扩散
发病期 7 天一次，连喷 2~3 次，注意轮换药剂
en-US: Remove severely infected lower leaves to improve airflow
Reduce nitrogen, increase potassium
Misting leaves morning/evening suppresses spore spread
Spray every 7 days, 2-3 rounds, rotate chemicals

zh-CN: 醚菌酯 2500 倍液
戊唑醇 3000 倍液
枯草芽孢杆菌 800 倍液（生物）
en-US: Kresoxim-methyl 1:2500
Tebuconazole 1:3000
Bacillus subtilis 1:800 (biological)

zh-CN: 叶片出现长梭形灰褐色大斑，长可达 10 厘米以上
病斑常连片，严重时整叶枯死
潮湿时病斑表面生灰黑色霉层
en-US: Long spindle-shaped grey-brown lesions, often over 10 cm
Lesions merge; whole leaves may die
Grey-black mould on lesions in humid weather

cause.zh-CN: 由大斑凸脐蠕孢菌引起。中温高湿（20~25℃）、多雨多露时流行，连作和密植加重发病。
cause.en-US: Caused by Exserohilum turcicum. Epidemic under moderate temperature, high humidity and frequent dew; worsened by continuous cropping and dense planting.

zh-CN: 收获后深翻灭茬，清除田间病残体
选用抗病品种，合理密植
心叶末期至抽雄期是防治关键期
增施钾肥提高抗病力
en-US: Deep plough after harvest to bury residues
Use resistant hybrids and proper plant density
Critical window: late whorl to tasselling
Increase potassium to boost resistance

zh-CN: 苯醚甲环唑 1500 倍液
吡唑醚菌酯 1500 倍液
丙环唑 2000 倍液
en-US: Difenoconazole 1:1500
Pyraclostrobin 1:1500
Propiconazole 1:2000

zh-CN: 叶片正面出现近圆形橄榄绿霉状斑
后期病斑变黑褐色，叶片扭曲早落
果实受害形成木栓化黑疤
en-US: Olive-green velvety round spots on upper leaf surface
Spots darken, leaves curl and drop early
Fruit develops corky black scabs

cause.zh-CN: 由苹果黑星菌引起。春季多雨、气温 15~20℃ 时孢子大量释放，是全年发病基础。
cause.en-US: Caused by Venturia inaequalis. Rainy spring at 15-20C triggers heavy spore release that determines the whole season.

zh-CN: 清扫落叶并深埋，减少越冬菌源
发芽前喷石硫合剂铲除越冬病菌
花后至幼果期是保叶保果关键期
雨季适当疏枝，改善果园通风
en-US: Collect and bury fallen leaves to cut overwintering inoculum
Apply lime-sulphur before bud break
Protect leaves from petal fall to young fruit stage
Prune for better orchard airflow in the rainy season

zh-CN: 苯醚甲环唑 2000 倍液
氟硅唑 4000 倍液
代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
en-US: Difenoconazole 1:2000
Flusilazole 1:4000
Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)

zh-CN: 叶背先出现针头状黄色油渍斑
病斑隆起呈火山口状，中央木栓化开裂
病斑周围有黄色晕圈，严重时落叶落果
en-US: Pinpoint yellow water-soaked spots start on the leaf underside
Lesions rise into a crater shape with corky, cracked centre
Yellow halo around lesions; heavy defoliation and fruit drop

cause.zh-CN: 由地毯草黄单胞菌柑橘致病变种引起。风雨、潜叶蛾危害伤口是主要侵染途径，属检疫性病害。
cause.en-US: Caused by Xanthomonas citri. Wind-driven rain and leaf-miner wounds are the main entry points. A quarantine disease.

zh-CN: 严格执行苗木检疫，不从疫区调苗
及时防治潜叶蛾，减少伤口
剪除病枝病叶并集中烧毁，工具要消毒
台风暴雨前后各喷一次药保护嫩梢
en-US: Enforce nursery quarantine; never move plants from infested areas
Control leaf miners to reduce wounds
Prune and burn infected shoots; disinfect tools
Spray before and after storms to protect new flush

zh-CN: 噻菌铜 500 倍液
春雷霉素 800 倍液
波尔多液 1:1:100（保护性）
en-US: Thiodiazole-copper 1:500
Kasugamycin 1:800
Bordeaux mixture 1:1:100 (protective)

zh-CN: 叶片出现梭形病斑，中央灰白、边缘褐色
病斑两端有褐色坏死线，湿度大时背面生灰绿霉
穗颈受害变褐，形成白穗
en-US: Spindle-shaped lesions with grey-white centre and brown margin
Brown necrotic lines extend from lesion tips; grey-green mould underneath in humid air
Neck infection turns brown and causes white empty panicles

cause.zh-CN: 由稻梨孢菌引起。阴雨多露、日照不足、氮肥偏多、长期深水灌溉时最易流行。
cause.en-US: Caused by Magnaporthe oryzae. Epidemics follow cloudy wet weather, low sunshine, excess nitrogen and deep continuous flooding.

zh-CN: 选用抗病品种，种子播前药剂浸种
控氮增钾硅，避免偏施迟施氮肥
分蘖末期适时晒田，降低田间湿度
破口期和齐穗期是防治关键，各喷一次药
en-US: Use resistant varieties and treat seed before sowing
Balance nitrogen with potassium and silicon; avoid late heavy N
Drain fields at late tillering to cut humidity
Spray at boot breaking and full heading - the two critical windows

zh-CN: 三环唑 1000 倍液（预防首选）
稻瘟灵 1000 倍液
春雷霉素 800 倍液
en-US: Tricyclazole 1:1000 (first choice for prevention)
Isoprothiolane 1:1000
Kasugamycin 1:800

zh-CN: 下部叶片正面出现白色霉点，逐渐连成粉状霉层
霉层后期变灰褐色，上生黑色小点
叶片黄化早枯，植株矮小，穗小粒少
en-US: White mildew spots on lower leaf surfaces, merging into powder
Mildew turns grey-brown with tiny black bodies late
Leaves yellow and die early; plants stunted with small heads

cause.zh-CN: 由禾本科布氏白粉菌引起。群体密度大、通风差、湿度高、氮肥多时发病重。
cause.en-US: Caused by Blumeria graminis. Favoured by dense canopy, poor airflow, high humidity and heavy nitrogen.

zh-CN: 合理密植，避免群体过大
控氮增磷钾，防止倒伏和贪青
拔节至孕穗期及时用药控制
清除田间自生麦苗，减少菌源
en-US: Keep moderate plant density
Balance nitrogen with P and K
Treat between jointing and booting
Remove volunteer wheat plants that carry inoculum

zh-CN: 三唑酮 1000 倍液
戊唑醇 3000 倍液
醚菌酯 2500 倍液
en-US: Triadimefon 1:1000
Tebuconazole 1:3000
Kresoxim-methyl 1:2500

zh-CN: 老叶先均匀褪绿发黄，新叶仍较绿
黄化由叶尖沿中脉向内扩展，整叶淡黄
植株矮小，分蘖或分枝明显减少
en-US: Older leaves yellow evenly first while new leaves stay green
Yellowing spreads from tip along the midrib
Plants are stunted with fewer tillers or branches

cause.zh-CN: 土壤速效氮不足，或基肥用量少、淋溶损失大；沙质土和雨后易发生。
cause.en-US: Low available soil nitrogen, insufficient basal fertiliser or heavy leaching; common on sandy soils and after rain.

zh-CN: 追施尿素每亩 8~12 公斤，兑水浇施或雨后撒施
配合叶面喷施 1% 尿素溶液，5 天一次连喷两次
增施有机肥改善保肥能力
注意与缺镁区分：缺镁黄化从叶脉间开始
en-US: Top-dress urea 8-12 kg per mu with water or after rain
Foliar spray 1% urea, twice at 5-day interval
Add organic matter to improve nutrient retention
Distinguish from magnesium deficiency, which yellows between veins

zh-CN: 无药剂，属营养问题
可配 1% 尿素 + 0.2% 磷酸二氢钾叶面肥
en-US: No pesticide needed; this is a nutrition issue
Foliar: 1% urea + 0.2% monopotassium phosphate

zh-CN: 老叶叶背和叶缘呈紫红色
植株矮小，叶片窄而直立
根系发育差，成熟延迟
en-US: Undersides and margins of older leaves turn purple-red
Plants stunted, leaves narrow and upright
Poor root development and delayed maturity

cause.zh-CN: 土壤有效磷低，或低温、土壤板结导致根系吸磷受阻；酸性土和石灰性土都易发生。
cause.en-US: Low available phosphorus, or restricted uptake caused by cold soil and compaction; occurs on both acid and calcareous soils.

zh-CN: 基施过磷酸钙或钙镁磷肥，每亩 30~40 公斤
叶面喷施 0.2%~0.3% 磷酸二氢钾，连喷 2~3 次
低温季节增施有机肥提高地温
注意与缺钾区分：缺钾是老叶叶缘先焦枯
en-US: Basal superphosphate or fused phosphate 30-40 kg per mu
Foliar 0.2-0.3% monopotassium phosphate, 2-3 rounds
Add organic matter in cold seasons to warm soil
Distinguish from potassium deficiency, which scorches leaf margins first

zh-CN: 无药剂，属营养问题
可配 0.3% 磷酸二氢钾叶面肥
en-US: No pesticide needed; this is a nutrition issue
Foliar: 0.3% monopotassium phosphate

zh-CN: 嫩梢和叶背群集大量小虫，虫体绿色或黑色
叶片卷曲皱缩，表面有油亮蜜露
蜜露诱发煤污病，叶片发黑
严重时植株生长停滞
en-US: Dense colonies on tender shoots and leaf undersides, green or black
Leaves curl and wrinkle, coated with shiny honeydew
Sooty mould grows on honeydew and blackens leaves
Severe infestations stop plant growth

cause.zh-CN: 蚜虫繁殖极快，一头雌蚜可孤雌繁殖数十头后代。高温干旱、天敌少时爆发。
cause.en-US: Aphids reproduce extremely fast by parthenogenesis. Outbreaks follow hot dry weather with few natural enemies.

zh-CN: 黄板诱杀有翅蚜，每亩挂 20~30 块
保护瓢虫、草蛉等天敌
点片发生时及时挑治，不必全田用药
清除田边杂草，减少虫源
en-US: Hang 20-30 yellow sticky boards per mu to trap winged aphids
Conserve ladybirds and lacewings
Spot-treat early colonies instead of spraying whole fields
Clear field-edge weeds that harbour aphids

zh-CN: 吡虫啉 2000 倍液
啶虫脒 3000 倍液
苦参碱 800 倍液（生物）
en-US: Imidacloprid 1:2000
Acetamiprid 1:3000
Matrine 1:800 (biological)

zh-CN: 叶面密布针头大小的黄白色失绿小点
叶背可见细小蛛丝和爬行小虫
叶片由黄转褐焦枯，似被火烤
严重时整株叶片脱落
en-US: Tiny yellowish-white stippling covers the leaf surface
Fine webbing and moving mites on the underside
Leaves turn yellow then scorched brown
Heavy infestations defoliate the plant

cause.zh-CN: 高温干旱是主要诱因，25~30℃ 时繁殖最快。长期单一用药易产生抗性。
cause.en-US: Driven by hot dry weather; fastest reproduction at 25-30C. Repeated use of one chemical quickly breeds resistance.

zh-CN: 及时清除田边杂草和受害重叶
适当增加田间湿度，抑制繁殖
交替使用不同作用机理的杀螨剂，避免抗性
叶片正反面都要喷到，重点是叶背
en-US: Remove edge weeds and heavily infested leaves
Raise field humidity to slow reproduction
Alternate acaricides with different modes of action
Spray both leaf surfaces, especially the underside

zh-CN: 阿维菌素 2000 倍液
哒螨灵 2000 倍液
联苯肼酯 2000 倍液
en-US: Abamectin 1:2000
Pyridaben 1:2000
Bifenazate 1:2000

zh-CN: 稻丛基部群集大量若虫和成虫
植株养分被吸走，茎秆变软发黑
田间出现成团枯死，俗称“冒穿”
严重时全田倒伏绝收
en-US: Dense nymph and adult clusters at the base of rice clumps
Plants weaken, stems soften and blacken
Circular patches of dead rice, known as hopperburn
Severe outbreaks cause total lodging and crop loss

cause.zh-CN: 由褐飞虱吸食汁液并传播病毒病。迁入期遇上高温高湿、田间郁闭时爆发。
cause.en-US: Caused by brown planthopper feeding and virus transmission. Outbreaks when immigration meets hot humid weather and a dense canopy.

zh-CN: 分蘖末期适时晒田，破坏低龄若虫环境
选用抗虫品种，避免偏施氮肥
保护稻田蜘蛛、黑肩绿盲蝽等天敌
虫量达标立即用药，药液要喷到稻丛基部
en-US: Drain fields at late tillering to disrupt young nymphs
Use resistant varieties and avoid excess nitrogen
Conserve spiders and mirid bugs
Spray once thresholds are met, directing spray to the plant base

zh-CN: 吡蚜酮 2000 倍液
烯啶虫胺 2000 倍液
金龟子绿僵菌 800 倍液（生物）
en-US: Pymetrozine 1:2000
Nitenpyram 1:2000
Metarhizium anisopliae 1:800 (biological)

zh-CN: 心叶期幼虫蛀入心叶，展开后呈横排排孔
茎秆内被蛀空，遇风易折断
穗期蛀食籽粒和穗轴，造成瘪粒
en-US: Larvae tunnel into the whorl, producing rows of holes when leaves unfurl
Stalks hollowed out and snap in wind
Larvae feed on kernels and cob, causing shrivelled grain

cause.zh-CN: 由亚洲玉米螟幼虫蛀食。越冬基数大、秸秆未处理、暖冬年份发生重。
cause.en-US: Caused by Asian corn borer larvae. Worse after mild winters, high overwintering populations and unprocessed crop residues.

zh-CN: 越冬期处理秸秆，消灭越冬幼虫
心叶末期是最佳防治窗口，用颗粒剂灌心
释放赤眼蜂寄生卵块，每亩 1.5 万头
夜间点灯诱杀成虫
en-US: Process crop residues in winter to kill overwintering larvae
Late whorl stage is the key window - apply granules into the whorl
Release Trichogramma wasps at 15000 per mu
Use light traps at night for adults

zh-CN: 氯虫苯甲酰胺 3000 倍液
辛硫磷颗粒剂 灌心
苏云金杆菌 800 倍液（生物）
en-US: Chlorantraniliprole 1:3000
Phoxim granules into the whorl
Bacillus thuringiensis 1:800 (biological)

zh-CN: 喷药后 1~3 天突发，全田均匀一致
叶片出现焦边、白化斑或油渍状斑
新叶畸形成杯状或蕨叶状
地边、重叠喷药处症状更重
en-US: Sudden onset 1-3 days after spraying, uniform across the field
Leaf scorching, bleaching or oily lesions
New leaves cupped or fern-like
Worse along borders and spray overlaps

cause.zh-CN: 用药浓度过高、高温时段喷药、混用不当或除草剂飘移所致。属人为因素，与病原无关。
cause.en-US: Caused by over-concentration, spraying in the heat of day, incompatible tank mixes or herbicide drift. Man-made, not pathogenic.

zh-CN: 立即喷清水冲洗叶面，稀释残留药液
追施速效氮肥和叶面肥促进恢复
中耕松土，增强根系活力
记录用药品种浓度，避免下次重复
en-US: Rinse foliage with clean water immediately to dilute residues
Top-dress quick nitrogen and foliar fertiliser to aid recovery
Loosen soil to boost root activity
Record the product and dose to avoid repeating the mistake

zh-CN: 无杀菌杀虫剂可用，避免二次伤害
可喷 0.2% 磷酸二氢钾 + 芸苔素内酯缓解
en-US: Do not apply more pesticides - avoid compounding the damage
Use 0.2% monopotassium phosphate plus brassinolide to alleviate

zh-CN: 叶片先出现紫色小点，扩大成边缘紫褐、中央灰褐的"蛙眼状"斑
果实出现褐色腐烂，后期干缩成黑色僵果挂在树上
枝干形成红褐色溃疡斑，树皮开裂
en-US: Purple flecks enlarge into 'frog-eye' spots with purple-brown rims and grey centres
Fruit rots brown and shrivels into black mummies that stay on the tree
Reddish-brown cankers form on branches and the bark cracks

cause.zh-CN: 由葡萄座腔菌引起。高温高湿、树势衰弱、虫伤和日灼伤口多时发病重；僵果和枝干溃疡是主要越冬菌源。
cause.en-US: Caused by Botryosphaeria obtusa. Favoured by warm humid weather, weak trees and sunburn or insect wounds; mummified fruit and cankers carry the fungus over winter.

zh-CN: 及时摘除僵果、剪掉溃疡枝并带出园外烧毁
增施有机肥、合理负载，恢复树势
雨季前开始保护性用药，15 天一次
防治食心虫、吉丁虫，减少伤口
en-US: Pick off mummified fruit and prune out cankers, then burn them off-site
Apply organic manure and thin the crop load to restore vigour
Start protective sprays before the rainy season, every 15 days
Control fruit borers and bark beetles to reduce wounds

zh-CN: 苯醚甲环唑 2000 倍液
代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
甲基硫菌灵 800 倍液
en-US: Difenoconazole 1:2000
Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)
Thiophanate-methyl 1:800

zh-CN: 叶正面出现橙黄色圆形斑，表面稍隆起
后期病斑中央生出黑色小点，边缘产生淡黄色晕圈
叶背对应位置长出黄色管状锈孢子器，像一撮小胡须
en-US: Bright orange-yellow circular spots with a slightly raised surface on the upper leaf
Dark dots appear in the centre of spots, ringed by a pale halo
Yellow tube-like spore horns form on the matching lower surface, like tiny whiskers

cause.zh-CN: 由山田胶锈菌引起，属**转主寄生**：冬季在桧柏等柏科植物上越冬，春季孢子随风飘到苹果上侵染。果园附近柏树多、春季多雨时发病重。
cause.en-US: Caused by Gymnosporangium rusts, which are heteroecious: they overwinter on junipers and their spores blow to apple in spring. Severe where junipers grow nearby and springs are wet.

zh-CN: 铲除果园周围 5 公里内的桧柏，或春季在柏树上喷药断掉菌源
苹果萌芽期至幼果期是防侵染关键期
雨前抢喷保护性药剂，雨后补喷治疗性药剂
适当疏枝，加快叶面干燥
en-US: Remove junipers within about 5 km, or spray the junipers in spring to break the cycle
The key window is from bud break to young fruit
Spray protectants before rain and a curative after
Thin the canopy so leaves dry faster

zh-CN: 三唑酮 1500 倍液
苯醚甲环唑 2000 倍液
氟硅唑 4000 倍液
en-US: Triadimefon 1:1500
Difenoconazole 1:2000
Flusilazole 1:4000

zh-CN: 叶片出现灰褐色长矩形病斑，两端平截、受叶脉限制
病斑沿叶脉平行扩展，多个连片后叶片大面积枯死
潮湿时病斑背面可见灰白色霉层
en-US: Greyish-brown rectangular lesions with square ends, bounded by leaf veins
Lesions run parallel to the veins and merge, killing large leaf areas
Grey-white mould appears on the underside in humid weather

cause.zh-CN: 由玉蜀黍尾孢引起。高温高湿（25~30℃）、多雨多露、密植郁闭时流行很快，病残体和种子可带菌。
cause.en-US: Caused by Cercospora zeae-maydis. Spreads fast under warm humid conditions (25-30 C) with frequent rain and dew, especially in dense stands; survives in residue and seed.

zh-CN: 收获后深翻灭茬，清除田间病残体
选用抗病品种，合理密植
大喇叭口期至抽雄期是防治关键期
增施钾肥、避免偏施氮肥
en-US: Plough in residue after harvest to bury the inoculum
Use resistant hybrids and avoid over-dense planting
The critical window is from the whorl stage to tasselling
Apply enough potassium and avoid excess nitrogen

zh-CN: 苯醚甲环唑 1500 倍液
吡唑醚菌酯 1500 倍液
代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
en-US: Difenoconazole 1:1500
Pyraclostrobin 1:1500
Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)

zh-CN: 叶片正反面散生褐色圆形或长圆形疱斑（夏孢子堆）
疱斑表皮破裂后散出褐色粉末，手摸会沾上
后期疱斑变为黑色（冬孢子堆），叶片提早枯黄
en-US: Scattered brown round-to-oval pustules on both leaf surfaces
Pustules rupture and release brown powder that rubs off on your fingers
Later they turn black and leaves yellow and dry prematurely

cause.zh-CN: 由高粱柄锈菌引起。温暖湿润、昼夜温差大、结露时间长时流行；孢子可随气流远距离传播。
cause.en-US: Caused by Puccinia sorghi. Favoured by warm humid weather with large day-night temperature swings and long dew periods; spores travel long distances on the wind.

zh-CN: 选用抗锈品种是最经济的办法
清除田间病残体，减少越冬菌源
发病初期及时用药，7~10 天一次
增施钾肥提高抗病力
en-US: Resistant hybrids are the cheapest control
Clean up crop residue to reduce overwintering inoculum
Spray early at first pustules, every 7-10 days
Apply potassium to strengthen plant resistance

zh-CN: 三唑酮 1500 倍液
戊唑醇 3000 倍液
苯醚甲环唑 1500 倍液
en-US: Triadimefon 1:1500
Tebuconazole 1:3000
Difenoconazole 1:1500

zh-CN: 叶片出现褐色圆形斑，中央灰白、边缘深褐，上生黑色小点
果实先变褐软腐，几天内干缩成黑色僵果挂在穗上
新梢和卷须出现黑褐色长条斑
en-US: Brown circular leaf spots with grey centres, dark margins and black dots
Berries turn brown, rot softly then shrivel into black mummies on the cluster
Dark elongated lesions appear on shoots and tendrils

cause.zh-CN: 由葡萄球座菌引起。梅雨或连阴雨、高温高湿（25~30℃）时爆发；僵果和病叶是主要越冬菌源，雨水飞溅传播。
cause.en-US: Caused by Guignardia bidwellii. Explodes during plum rains or prolonged wet spells at 25-30 C; mummified berries and fallen leaves carry it over winter and rain splash spreads it.

zh-CN: 秋季彻底清除僵果、病叶和病枝，集中烧毁
及时绑蔓摘心，改善通风透光
坐果后及时套袋
谢花后至封穗前是防治关键期，10 天一次
en-US: Remove and burn mummies, infected leaves and cankers in autumn
Tie and tip shoots promptly to open up the canopy
Bag clusters soon after fruit set
The key window runs from petal fall to cluster closure, every 10 days

zh-CN: 代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
苯醚甲环唑 2000 倍液
嘧菌酯 2000 倍液
en-US: Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)
Difenoconazole 1:2000
Azoxystrobin 1:2000

zh-CN: 叶片脉间出现黄化或红褐色条带，边缘仍绿，呈"虎斑"状
病斑逐渐坏死，叶片边缘焦枯或整叶脱落
果穗变小、果实失水皱缩；剖开枝干可见木质部黑色坏死条纹
en-US: Interveinal yellow or red-brown bands while veins stay green, giving a tiger-stripe look
Bands die off, leaf margins scorch and leaves may drop
Clusters stay small and berries shrivel; cutting the trunk reveals black necrosis in the wood

cause.zh-CN: 由多种木质部真菌复合侵染引起。主要通过修剪伤口侵入，在木质部内逐年扩展；老龄园、干旱胁迫、大伤口多的园区发病重。**目前没有能根治的药剂。**
cause.en-US: A complex of wood-infecting fungi that enter through pruning wounds and spread slowly inside the wood. Worse in old vineyards, under drought stress and where large cuts are made. There is no curative chemical control.

zh-CN: 重点在预防：修剪后立即用伤口保护剂封闭切口
避免在雨天修剪，少做大伤口
及时挖除重病株并烧毁，不要留在地边
加强水肥、避免干旱胁迫，延缓发病
en-US: Prevention is everything: seal pruning wounds immediately
Do not prune in wet weather and avoid large cuts
Remove and burn severely affected vines
Keep water and nutrition up to avoid drought stress and slow the disease

zh-CN: 无根治药剂，不要轻信"神药"
修剪伤口可涂甲基硫菌灵糊剂保护
en-US: No curative product exists - beware of miracle cures
Seal pruning wounds with a thiophanate-methyl paste

zh-CN: 下部老叶先出现褐色多角形或不规则斑，受叶脉限制
病斑逐渐连片，叶背可见灰褐色霉层
叶片自下而上枯黄早落，果穗着色差
en-US: Brown angular or irregular spots on lower leaves first, bounded by veins
Spots merge and a grey-brown mould shows on the underside
Leaves yellow and drop from the bottom up; clusters colour poorly

cause.zh-CN: 由葡萄假尾孢引起。高温高湿、多雨多露的年份流行重；病落叶和枝蔓上的菌丝是主要越冬菌源。
cause.en-US: Caused by Pseudocercospora vitis. Severe in warm wet years with frequent rain and dew; fallen leaves and cane debris carry it over winter.

zh-CN: 秋季清扫落叶并深埋，减少越冬菌源
及时摘心绑蔓，改善通风透光
雨季前开始用药，10~14 天一次
增施钾肥，防止后期脱肥早衰
en-US: Collect and bury fallen leaves in autumn
Tip and tie shoots to open the canopy
Start spraying before the rains, every 10-14 days
Keep potassium up to prevent late-season decline

zh-CN: 代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
苯醚甲环唑 2000 倍液
异菌脲 1000 倍液
en-US: Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)
Difenoconazole 1:2000
Iprodione 1:1000

zh-CN: 叶片出现斑驳状黄化：黄绿相间、左右不对称，与缺素黄化不同
新梢抽发晚、数量少，叶片变小变硬
果实小、畸形、着色不均，果蒂附近仍青（"红鼻子果"）
树势逐年衰退，2~3 年内枯死
en-US: Blotchy mottle: yellow and green patches that are asymmetric across the midrib, unlike nutrient deficiency
New flushes are late, sparse and produce small hardened leaves
Fruit is small, lopsided and colours unevenly, staying green near the stem
Trees decline and die within 2-3 years

cause.zh-CN: 由韧皮部杆菌引起，由柑橘木虱传播，也可通过带病苗木和嫁接传播。**属检疫性病害，目前无药可治。**
cause.en-US: Caused by a phloem-limited bacterium spread by the Asian citrus psyllid, and also by infected nursery stock and grafting. It is a quarantine disease with no cure.

zh-CN: 发现病株立即整株挖除烧毁，越早越好，不要抱侥幸心理
统一防治柑橘木虱（新梢期是关键）
只使用有检疫合格证的无病苗木
连片园区要联防联控，单家清理效果有限
en-US: Remove and burn infected trees immediately - delay makes it worse
Control the psyllid vector on a community basis, especially at flush stages
Plant only certified disease-free nursery stock
Neighbouring orchards must act together; one farm alone will fail

zh-CN: 无治疗药剂，任何"治黄龙病"的药都不可信
防治木虱：吡虫啉、噻虫嗪、联苯菊酯（新梢期喷）
en-US: No cure exists - any product claiming to treat HLB is fraudulent
For the psyllid: imidacloprid, thiamethoxam or bifenthrin at flush stages

zh-CN: 叶片出现水渍状小点，后变紫褐色圆形斑，周围有黄色晕圈
病斑干枯后脱落，叶片形成圆形穿孔，严重时落叶
果实出现褐色凹陷斑，表面开裂，影响卖相
en-US: Water-soaked flecks become purple-brown round spots with yellow halos
Spots dry and drop out leaving shot-holes; heavy infection causes defoliation
Fruit shows brown sunken spots that crack and ruin market value

cause.zh-CN: 由黄单胞菌引起。细菌在枝条病斑内越冬，春季随风雨、昆虫从气孔和伤口侵入；多雨、密植、排水不良、树势弱时发病重。
cause.en-US: Caused by Xanthomonas bacteria that overwinter in branch lesions and enter through stomata and wounds via rain, wind and insects. Severe in wet years, dense plantings and poorly drained, weak orchards.

zh-CN: 清扫落叶、剪除病枝并带出园外烧毁
雨季前开沟排水，降低园内湿度
合理修剪，改善通风透光
避开发病期喷灌，减少叶面结露
en-US: Rake up leaves and prune out infected branches, then burn them off-site
Open drainage ditches before the rains to lower orchard humidity
Prune for airflow and light penetration
Avoid overhead irrigation during disease periods

zh-CN: 噻菌铜 500 倍液
春雷霉素 800 倍液
中生菌素 600 倍液
en-US: Thiodiazole-copper 1:500
Kasugamycin 1:800
Zhongshengmycin 1:600

zh-CN: 叶片出现水渍状小圆斑，后变褐、边缘有黄色晕圈
病斑密集时叶片黄化、大量脱落，形成"光秆"
果实出现褐色凸起的疮痂状斑，不深入果肉
en-US: Water-soaked round spots turn brown with yellow halos
Under heavy pressure leaves yellow and drop, exposing bare stems
Fruit develops raised brown scabby spots that stay shallow

cause.zh-CN: 由黄单胞菌引起。**种子可带菌**，是远距离传播的主要途径；田间靠雨水飞溅、浇水和管理操作传播。高温高湿、风雨后暴发快。
cause.en-US: Caused by Xanthomonas bacteria that travel long distances on seed. In the field they spread by rain splash, irrigation and handling. Outbreaks follow hot wet weather and storms.

zh-CN: 播种前用温汤浸种（55℃ 浸 15 分钟）或药剂拌种
与非茄科作物轮作 2 年以上
改喷灌为滴灌或沟灌，减少叶面飞溅
发现中心病株及时拔除，操作后工具要消毒
en-US: Treat seed before sowing: hot water at 55 C for 15 minutes, or a chemical seed dressing
Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for 2+ years
Switch from overhead to drip or furrow irrigation
Rogue out the first infected plants and disinfect tools

zh-CN: 氢氧化铜 800 倍液
噻菌铜 500 倍液
中生菌素 600 倍液
en-US: Copper hydroxide 1:800
Thiodiazole-copper 1:500
Zhongshengmycin 1:600

zh-CN: 下部老叶先出现褐色圆形斑，斑上有明显同心轮纹
病斑扩大后连片，叶片自下而上枯黄脱落
块茎出现褐色凹陷斑，切开后薯肉呈褐色干腐
en-US: Brown circular spots with clear concentric rings on lower leaves first
Spots merge and leaves yellow and drop from the bottom up
Tubers develop brown sunken lesions with dry brown rot inside

cause.zh-CN: 由茄链格孢菌引起。高温高湿、植株后期脱肥早衰、连作地块发病重；雨水和灌溉水飞溅传播。
cause.en-US: Caused by Alternaria solani. Favoured by warm humid weather, weak ageing plants and continuous cropping; spread by rain and irrigation splash.

zh-CN: 与非茄科作物轮作 2 年以上
清除田间病残体，收获后深翻
增施钾肥、防止后期脱肥早衰
发病初期开始用药，7~10 天一次
en-US: Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for 2+ years
Clear residue and plough deep after harvest
Apply potassium to prevent late-season decline
Spray from first symptoms, every 7-10 days

zh-CN: 苯醚甲环唑 1500 倍液
代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
嘧菌酯 2000 倍液
en-US: Difenoconazole 1:1500
Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)
Azoxystrobin 1:2000

zh-CN: 叶尖或叶缘出现暗绿色水渍状斑，迅速向叶内扩大
病斑由暗绿转褐色，叶背边缘可见一圈白色霉层
块茎出现褐色凹陷硬斑，切开薯肉呈锈褐色
流行时整片田一周内枯死，并有腐臭味
en-US: Dark green water-soaked lesions start at leaf tips or margins and spread fast
Lesions turn brown with a ring of white mould on the underside
Tubers get brown sunken firm lesions with rusty brown flesh inside
In an epidemic a whole field collapses within a week and smells of rot

cause.zh-CN: 由致病疫霉引起。低温高湿（18~22℃、相对湿度 90% 以上）时爆发极快，一晚即可毁田；带病种薯是主要初侵染源，孢子随风雨远距离传播。
cause.en-US: Caused by Phytophthora infestans. Explosive under cool wet conditions (18-22 C, RH above 90%) and can destroy a field overnight; infected seed tubers are the main source and spores travel with wind and rain.

zh-CN: 发现中心病株立即拔除并带出田外深埋，这是最要紧的一步
选用无病种薯，切刀要消毒
雨前抢喷保护性药剂，雨后补喷治疗性药剂
收获前 1~2 周杀秧，避免病菌落到块茎上
en-US: Rogue out and deep-bury the first infected plants immediately - this matters most
Plant certified seed and disinfect cutting knives
Spray a protectant before rain and a curative afterwards
Destroy haulm 1-2 weeks before harvest to protect tubers

zh-CN: 烯酰吗啉 800 倍液
霜脲·锰锌 600 倍液
氟菌·霜霉威 800 倍液
en-US: Dimethomorph 1:800
Cymoxanil plus mancozeb 1:600
Fluopicolide plus propamocarb 1:800

zh-CN: 叶面散生紫红色小点，逐渐扩大成紫褐色不规则斑
病斑密集时叶片呈"焦枯"状，但斑上无明显轮纹
叶片边缘上卷，严重时整叶枯死
en-US: Small purplish-red flecks spread and enlarge into purplish-brown irregular spots
Heavy spotting gives a scorched look, but without concentric rings
Leaf margins curl upward and leaves may die entirely

cause.zh-CN: 由草莓双盘菌引起。高温高湿、密植郁闭、通风不良时发病重；病叶在土表越冬，雨水飞溅传播。
cause.en-US: Caused by Diplocarpon earlianum. Severe under warm humid conditions in dense, poorly ventilated beds; infected leaves overwinter on the soil surface and splash up with rain.

zh-CN: 及时摘除老叶病叶并带出园外销毁
合理密植，保持行间通风
改喷灌为滴灌，避免叶面长时间湿润
采果后及时清园，减少越冬菌源
en-US: Remove old and infected leaves and destroy them off-site
Keep planting density sensible so rows stay ventilated
Use drip instead of overhead irrigation to keep foliage dry
Clean up the bed after harvest to cut overwintering inoculum

zh-CN: 苯醚甲环唑 2000 倍液
代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
嘧菌酯 2000 倍液
en-US: Difenoconazole 1:2000
Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)
Azoxystrobin 1:2000

zh-CN: 叶片出现水渍状小圆斑，后变褐、周围有黄色晕圈
果实出现褐色凸起小斑，像"雀斑"，不深入果肉
茎和叶柄出现褐色长条斑，严重时叶片大量脱落
en-US: Water-soaked round spots turn brown with yellow halos
Fruit gets small raised brown 'freckles' that stay shallow
Dark streaks appear on stems and petioles; heavy infection defoliates plants

cause.zh-CN: 由黄单胞菌引起。**种子带菌**是主要初侵染源；田间靠雨水飞溅和农事操作传播，高温高湿、多风雨时暴发。
cause.en-US: Caused by Xanthomonas bacteria carried on seed, which is the main primary source. In the field it spreads by rain splash and handling, and explodes in hot wet windy weather.

zh-CN: 播种前温汤浸种（55℃ 浸 15 分钟）或药剂拌种
与非茄科作物轮作 2 年以上
改喷灌为滴灌，避免叶面飞溅和长时间湿润
及时摘除病叶病果，操作后工具消毒
en-US: Treat seed with hot water at 55°C for 15 minutes or a chemical dressing
Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for 2+ years
Use drip rather than overhead irrigation
Remove infected leaves and fruit and disinfect tools

zh-CN: 氢氧化铜 800 倍液
噻菌铜 500 倍液
中生菌素 600 倍液
en-US: Copper hydroxide 1:800
Thiodiazole-copper 1:500
Zhongshengmycin 1:600

zh-CN: 叶正面出现淡黄色不规则斑，边缘不明显
叶背对应位置初生白色霉层，后转灰褐色至深褐色绒状霉
病斑扩展后叶片卷曲干枯，由下部叶片向上蔓延
en-US: Pale yellow irregular patches with indistinct margins on the upper leaf
The matching underside first shows white mould, turning grey-brown to dark velvety
Leaves curl and dry as spots spread upward from the bottom

cause.zh-CN: 由黄褐孢霉引起。**棚室高温高湿（20~25℃、相对湿度 90% 以上）时最重**，是保护地番茄的主要病害；种子和病残体可带菌。
cause.en-US: Caused by Passalora fulva, worst in greenhouses at 20-25°C with humidity above 90%, where it is a major disease. Seed and crop debris carry the fungus.

zh-CN: 控湿是第一位：晴天上午放风排湿，避免叶面结露
摘除下部病叶，改善通风透光
棚室可用烟剂熏蒸，避免喷雾加湿
拉秧后彻底清园，棚膜和架材消毒
en-US: Humidity control comes first: ventilate on sunny mornings and avoid leaf condensation
Remove lower infected leaves to improve airflow
Use smoke generators in greenhouses instead of sprays that add moisture
Clean the house thoroughly after the crop and disinfect structures

zh-CN: 嘧菌酯 2000 倍液
苯醚甲环唑 2000 倍液
腐霉利烟剂（棚室，傍晚熏烟）
en-US: Azoxystrobin 1:2000
Difenoconazole 1:2000
Procymidone smoke generator (greenhouse, at dusk)

zh-CN: 下部老叶先出现水渍状小圆斑，后扩大成中央灰白、边缘深褐的圆形斑
病斑上密生**黑色小点**（分生孢子器），这是与早疫病的关键区别
病斑密集时叶片枯黄脱落，由下往上蔓延
en-US: Water-soaked spots on lower leaves enlarge into circles with grey centres and dark margins
Tiny black dots (pycnidia) pepper the spots - the key difference from early blight
Heavy spotting yellows and drops leaves, spreading upward

cause.zh-CN: 由番茄壳针孢引起。高温高湿、多雨多露时发病重；病残体和野生茄科植物是越冬场所，雨水飞溅和农事操作传播。
cause.en-US: Caused by Septoria lycopersici. Severe in warm wet weather with frequent rain and dew; it overwinters in crop debris and wild solanaceous plants and spreads by splash and handling.

zh-CN: 彻底清除病叶病残体，不要留在田里
与非茄科作物轮作 2 年以上
改喷灌为滴灌，减少叶面飞溅
发病初期开始用药，7~10 天一次
en-US: Remove infected leaves and debris completely
Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for 2+ years
Use drip irrigation instead of overhead to cut splash
Spray from first symptoms, every 7-10 days

zh-CN: 代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
苯醚甲环唑 1500 倍液
嘧菌酯 2000 倍液
en-US: Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)
Difenoconazole 1:1500
Azoxystrobin 1:2000

zh-CN: 叶片出现褐色圆形斑，有**明显的同心轮纹**，形似靶心
病斑中央灰白至灰褐，外缘常有黄色晕圈
病斑密集时叶片枯死，棚室中发展很快
en-US: Brown circular spots with strong concentric rings, looking like a target
Centres are grey to grey-brown with a yellow halo around the margin
Heavy infection kills leaves and it spreads quickly in greenhouses

cause.zh-CN: 由多主棒孢菌引起。高温高湿（25~30℃）、棚室结露时间长、通风不良时发病重；病残体在土壤中越冬。
cause.en-US: Caused by Corynespora cassiicola. Favoured by 25-30°C with long leaf wetness and poor ventilation in protected crops; survives in soil debris.

zh-CN: 控湿通风是基础，晴天上午及时放风
摘除病叶并带出棚外销毁
拉秧后彻底清园，土壤深翻
发病初期用药，7 天一次，注意轮换
en-US: Ventilate on sunny mornings to keep foliage dry
Remove infected leaves and destroy them off-site
Clean up thoroughly after the crop and plough the soil
Spray from first symptoms every 7 days, rotating products

zh-CN: 苯醚甲环唑 1500 倍液
嘧菌酯 2000 倍液
代森锰锌 600 倍液（保护性）
en-US: Difenoconazole 1:1500
Azoxystrobin 1:2000
Mancozeb 1:600 (protective)

zh-CN: 新叶变小、**叶缘向上卷曲**、叶片皱缩发硬
叶脉间黄化，整株叶色黄绿，下部老叶反而正常
植株明显矮化、节间缩短，**不结果或只结很小的果**
en-US: New leaves are small, **curl upward** at the margins and become puckered and stiff
Interveinal yellowing gives a pale yellow-green plant while older leaves stay normal
Plants are stunted with short internodes and set no fruit or only tiny fruit

cause.zh-CN: 由番茄黄化曲叶病毒引起，**由烟粉虱传播**。病毒本身**没有药剂可治**，一旦感病只能拔除。苗期感染的损失最大。
cause.en-US: Caused by TYLCV and spread by the whitefly Bemisia tabaci. There is **no chemical cure** for the virus itself; infected plants must be removed. Infection at the seedling stage causes the worst losses.

zh-CN: **防虫网 + 防住烟粉虱是唯一有效的办法**（育苗棚就要上 60 目防虫网）
黄板诱杀成虫，及时清除棚边杂草
发现病株立即拔除并带出田外销毁
选用抗病品种，苗期重点保护
en-US: **Insect-proof netting plus whitefly control is the only effective measure** (use 60-mesh netting in the nursery)
Use yellow sticky traps and clear weeds around the house
Rogue out and destroy infected plants immediately
Grow resistant varieties and protect the seedling stage above all

zh-CN: 病毒无药可治，任何"治病毒"的药剂都不可信
防烟粉虱：噻虫嗪、吡虫啉、螺虫乙酯（重点在苗期）
en-US: No product can cure the virus - any claim to do so is fraudulent
For whitefly: thiamethoxam, imidacloprid or spirotetramat, especially at seedling stage

zh-CN: 叶片出现**黄绿相间的花叶斑驳**，深浅不匀
新叶变窄、扭曲，叶面凹凸不平（蕨叶状）
果实出现花脸斑或褐色坏死斑，品质下降
en-US: Mottled yellow and green patches of uneven shade across the leaf
New leaves are narrow, twisted and puckered, sometimes fern-like
Fruit shows mottling or brown necrotic patches and loses quality

cause.zh-CN: 由烟草花叶病毒引起，**主要是接触传播** —— 农事操作时手、工具、衣物都能带毒，种子也可带毒。**病毒本身无药可治。**高温干旱、重茬地块发病重。
cause.en-US: Caused by TMV, spread mainly by contact: hands, tools and clothing carry the virus during routine work, and seed can too. There is no chemical cure. Worse in hot dry weather and continuous cropping.

zh-CN: **操作前用肥皂水洗手、工具消毒**（这是最有效的措施，比打药管用）
播种前种子用 10% 磷酸三钠浸 20 分钟消毒
发现病株立即拔除，不要用手摸了病株再摸健康株
与非茄科作物轮作 2 年以上
en-US: **Wash hands with soap and disinfect tools before working** - this beats any spray
Soak seed in 10% trisodium phosphate for 20 minutes before sowing
Remove infected plants at once and do not touch healthy plants afterwards
Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for 2+ years

zh-CN: 病毒无药可治，防住接触传播才是关键
可喷氨基寡糖素、宁南霉素作辅助缓解，但不能治病
en-US: No cure exists; blocking contact spread is what matters
Aminooligosaccharide or ningnanmycin may ease symptoms but will not cure the plant

zh-CN: 叶色浓绿均匀，无失绿或坏死斑
叶片平展，无卷曲畸形
未见虫体、虫粪或蜜露
en-US: Uniform deep green colour without chlorosis or necrosis
Leaves flat and normally shaped
No insects, frass or honeydew observed

cause.zh-CN: 本次照片反映的叶面状态良好。建议保持现有管理水平并定期巡田。
cause.en-US: The submitted photo shows healthy foliage. Keep up the current management and scout regularly.

zh-CN: 继续保持合理的水肥管理
每 7 天巡田一次，重点检查叶背和心叶
雨天前后各查一次，及早发现中心病株
en-US: Maintain balanced irrigation and fertilisation
Scout weekly, focusing on leaf undersides and whorls
Check before and after rain to catch the first infected plants

zh-CN: 无需用药
en-US: No treatment required
